H1.statement: Recent PM2.5 concentrations are strong predictors of next-hour PM2.5.
H1.test: Set C vs C - PM2.5 history (current + lags + rolling); joint Wald test of the history block

H2.statement: Meteorological and pollutant measurements provide additional predictive information beyond historical PM2.5.
H2.test: Set C vs C - environment (pollutants, meteorology, wind direction, derived differences, interactions); joint Wald test of the environment block

H3.statement: PM2.5 has systematic hourly and weekly temporal patterns that can be captured using temporal features.
H3.test: Set C vs C - temporal (calendar terms and their hour interactions); joint Wald test; hourly/weekly/monthly decomposition reported

H4.statement: Rolling statistics of recent PM2.5 provide more stable predictive information than individual lag values.
H4.test: rolling-only history (C - lag) vs lag-only history (C - rolling), both keep PM2.5(t); predictive criterion = rolling-only has the lower CV-MAE by >= 1 % in >= 4 of 5 folds; inferential criterion = Diebold-Mariano test on out-of-fold absolute errors favours rolling-only (p < 0.05); stability (fold-to-fold std of MAE, coefficient spread) is reported alongside

decision_rule.verdicts: Supported = predictive AND inferential criterion; Partly supported = exactly one; Not supported = neither (verdicts use training CV / training inference only)

model_selection_rule.tie_tolerance: 1.0 standard error of the best model's fold MAEs
model_selection_rule.among_tied_families: decided by the data properties of the TRAINING design matrix: correlated groups AND many weak predictors -> ElasticNet; strong multicollinearity -> Ridge; many weak predictors -> Lasso; else OLS

missing_value_policy.target: never imputed; rows with missing PM2.5(t+1) dropped
missing_value_policy.other_variables: SimpleImputer inside each training fold (median numeric, most frequent wind direction)

derived_feature_rule: a Group-4 derived quantity is kept only if |Spearman| with the target or with the next-hour change is >= 0.1 on the training rows

decision_threshold.status: PROPOSED operational tolerance, not an authoritative standard; sensitivity grid reported

test_policy: locked until the design is frozen; evaluated once; never used for selection

amendments.stage: after training CV of the linear families, before the design freeze (test set locked)
amendments.change: a penalised family whose CV-optimal penalty is on the no-shrinkage edge of its grid is numerically OLS and is skipped in the property-implied preference list
amendments.reason: Best mean CV-MAE: Lasso (10.508); 1 SE = 0.577; families within 1 SE: ['OLS', 'Ridge', 'Lasso', 'ElasticNet']. Training-design properties: max VIF 376.7 (PM25_roll_mean_3), 10 features with VIF > 10; 3 correlated groups (|r| >= 0.8); 50.0% of features weak (|Spearman| < 0.1; threshold 50%). Implied family: ElasticNet (correlated groups of predictors AND many weak/redundant predictors -> feature selection that keeps correlated groups together); pre-registered outcome: ElasticNet. AMENDMENT: Ridge, ElasticNet have their CV-optimal penalty on the no-shrinkage edge of the grid (Ridge: {'alpha': 0.001}, 54/54 non-zero; ElasticNet: {'alpha': 9.999999999999999e-05, 'l1_ratio': 0.9}, 54/54 non-zero), i.e. numerically OLS, so they are skipped -> chosen: Lasso ({'alpha': 0.21544346900318845}, 29/54 non-zero).
